description: Join between PERMIT fixture atoms and Wu et al. (IEEE S&P 2026) permission items, as '<app>,<data type>' keys from data/user_study.json task3 answers. Only unresolved atoms (those a policy might ask about) need a mapping. 'fit' is close when app and data type both match the atom, loose when one of them is a substitute. Wu et al. have no representation axis (full event vs free/busy) and no operation axis, so those parts of the five-tuple are not reflected. Data: CC BY 4.0, Wu, Yang, Roesner, Kohno, Zhang, Iqbal.

t01_free_slot/list_day.why: agent reads one day's full calendar

t02_tell_bob_time/invite_bob.why: a colleague gets the full event; nearest Wu item is sharing meeting details from Calendar
